title: Step 1: Numbers to Short Codes
story: Short links like a.co/3fK use base 62: digits, lowercase and uppercase letters. First, turn a number into a code.
goal: Write encode(n) turning a number into base 62 text.
hints: divmod(n, 62) gives the next digit and what is left.
Put each new digit in front.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
